data.long_meaning: Ijliyah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'j-l-y' which means 'gentle' or 'soft'. It symbolizes the delicate beauty and fragility of nature, reminding us of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) saying, 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness.'
